interval_years.quote: a license for a home inspector issued under this article expires on a date established by the licensing agency under IC 25-1-6-4 and shall be renewed biennially upon payment of the required renewal fees.

required.quote: Before the end of each license period, each licensee must complete the continuing education required by the board.

hours_per_period.quote: This requirement may not exceed twenty (20) hours per year.

period_years.quote: This requirement may not exceed twenty (20) hours per year.

available.quote: The other licensing requirements of this chapter may be waived for an individual moving to Indiana from another jurisdiction, and the individual may be granted a license as a home inspector if the individual meets the following requirements

requirements.value: The other jurisdiction must grant the same privileges to Indiana licensees; the individual must be licensed in the other jurisdiction; the other jurisdiction's licensing requirements must be substantially similar to Indiana's; and the individual must state familiarity with and intent to abide by Indiana's article and rules.
requirements.quote: The other jurisdiction grants the same privileges to licensees of Indiana as Indiana grants to licensees of that other jurisdiction. (2) The individual is licensed in the other jurisdiction. (3) The licensing requirements of the other jurisdiction are substantially similar to the requirements of this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disclosing home inspection results without client approval or court order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disclosing information concerning the results of a home inspection without the approval of a client or the client's legal representative, except under a court order.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting compensation from more than one party for the same service without consent of all parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting compensation for the same service from more than one (1) party without the consent of all interested parties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting commissions or allowances from other parties dealing with the client in connection with recommended repair work.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting commissions or allowances, directly or indirectly, from other parties dealing with the licensee's client in connection with any repair work recommended in the licensee's home inspection report.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting compensation from the client in connection with recommended repair work.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting compensation, directly or indirectly, from the licensee's client in connection with any repair work recommended in the licensee's home inspection report.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose a business interest that may affect the client in connection with work the licensee is responsible for.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to disclose to a client information about a business interest of the licensee that may affect the client in connection with any work for which the licensee is responsible.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false or misleading representation about the condition of a residential dwelling or extent of services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making a false or misleading representation about: (A) the condition of a residential dwelling for which the licensee has performed or has contracted to perform a home inspection; or (B) the extent of the services the licensee has performed or will perform.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a felony in the course of the practice of home inspection or any act constituting a violation of licensure requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing a felony in the course of the practice of home inspection or committing any act constituting a violation of IC 25-20.2-5-2 (a)(1)(C).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the article or rules adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provisions of this article or rules adopted by the board under this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or misleading representation in a license or renewal application or information provided to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or misleading representation: (A) in a license or renewal application form; or (B) in information provided to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay any fees or fines required by this article.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to pay any fees or fines required by this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to continuously maintain the required insurance or other evidence of financial responsibility.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to continuously maintain the insurance or other evidence of financial responsibility required by this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Communicating false or misleading information to the public about the type of license held.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Communicating to the public false or misleading information about the type of license held by the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a course of lewd or immoral conduct in connection with the delivery of services to clients.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a course of lewd or immoral conduct in connection with the delivery of services to clients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete the continuing education requirements established by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to complete the continuing education requirements established by the board.

insurance_required.quote: Submit to the board a certificate of insurance or other evidence of financial responsibility that is acceptable to the board and that: (A) is issued by an insurance company or other legal entity authorized to transact business in Indiana; (B) provides for general liability coverage of at least one hundred thousand dollars ($100,000)

definition_quote.value: Home inspection means a visual analysis for the purpose of providing a professional opinion of the condition of a residential dwelling and the dwelling's carports or garages, any reasonably accessible installed components, and the operation of the dwelling's systems, including any controls normally operated by the owner of the dwelling, for the following components: (1) Heating systems. (2) Cooling systems. (3) Electrical systems. (4) Plumbing systems. (5) Structural components. (6) Foundations. (7) Roof coverings. (8) Exterior and interior components. (9) Attic spaces. (10) Basement or crawl space, if any. (11) Any other site aspects that affect the residential dwelling.
